tests.name: Port Scan
tests.description:
Scan ports to check for listening ports.

Upon successful execution, sh will perform a network connection against a single host (192.168.1.1) and determine what ports are open in the range of 1-65535. Results will be via stdout.

tests.name: Port Scan Nmap
tests.description:
Scan ports to check for listening ports with Nmap.
Upon successful execution, sh will utilize nmap, telnet, and nc to contact a single or range of addresses on port 80 to determine if listening. Results will be via stdout.

tests.name: Port Scan NMap for Windows
tests.description: Scan ports to check for listening ports for the local host 127.0.0.1

tests.name: Port Scan using python
tests.description: Scan ports to check for listening ports with python

tests.name: WinPwn - spoolvulnscan
tests.description: Start MS-RPRN RPC Service Scan using spoolvulnscan function of WinPwn

tests.name: WinPwn - MS17-10
tests.description: Search for MS17-10 vulnerable Windows Servers in the domain using powerSQL function of WinPwn

tests.name: WinPwn - bluekeep
tests.description: Search for bluekeep vulnerable Windows Systems in the domain using bluekeep function of WinPwn. Can take many minutes to complete (~600 seconds in testing on a small domain).

tests.name: WinPwn - fruit
tests.description: Search for potentially vulnerable web apps (low hanging fruits) using fruit function of WinPwn

tests.name: Network Service Discovery for Containers
tests.description: Attackers may try to obtain a list of services that are operating on remote hosts and local network infrastructure devices, in order to identify potential vulnerabilities that can be exploited through remote software attacks. They typically use tools to conduct port and vulnerability scans in order to obtain this information.

tests.name: Port-Scanning /24 Subnet with PowerShell
tests.description:
Scanning common ports in a /24 subnet. If no IP address for the target subnet is specified the test tries to determine the attacking machine's "primary" IPv4 address first and then scans that address with a /24 netmask.
The connection attempts to use a timeout parameter in milliseconds to speed up the scan. Please note the atomic might not print any output until the scans are completed.

tests.name: Remote Desktop Services Discovery via PowerShell
tests.description: Availability of remote desktop services can be checked using get- cmdlet of PowerShell

tests.name: Port Scan using nmap (Port range)
tests.description: Scan multiple ports to check for listening ports with nmap

tests.name: Windows - Port Scan using RustScan (Port list)
tests.description: Scan ports on a target host using RustScan. Downloads the portable RustScan release binary and scans 127.0.0.1 by default. Uses --greppable so that nmap is not a dependency.
